title: Premise grammar and sixty-six source rows: current probe and conditional sealing gap
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full historical premise palette reconciled with narrow current probe seam
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual228-line review covers F1–F5, H1–H6, every PD1–8/PC1–10/PS1–8/PY1–10/PV1–6/PK1–6/PE1–12 row, all world-fit rows, sealing/subtle details and S1–S5/later suggestions. Keep source-local codes distinct from overlapping prefixes elsewhere. The167premise/161verified counts describe the private metadata sample, not work-body reads or general audience consensus. The described dragon-egg clip remains unidentified; rejected near matches and unverified cultural recollection do not identify it. Its private premise files and upstream works were not read here.

F2: H4's multiple belief holders and second-order belief, H2's causal agent, H5's time/witness order and H6's optional payoff are useful authoring dimensions. Preserve caretaker/subject/dropper/neighbor seats, host-learned habits versus lineage, grief/cover-story motives, meaningful tokens, across-life role reversal and premise collisions. They need not become six compulsory engine fields, a single exposure/reputation scalar or a generic similarity probability. A mistaken belief can persist for a reason; it need not be maintained by making an informed observer ignore available evidence. Displaying irony requires both the player's learned truth and an actual channel to the other actor's belief.

F3: PE1's absent-premise-axis statement predates current source. Fresh scoped reads of src/start_probe_ui.js, src/premise_generator.js, src/start_records.js45–70 and src/main.js9560–9585 show the localhost/start_probe=1 probe wraps the existing resolver with premiseWorld; its source content declares public text layers, not sealed hidden-nature scenarios. Addressed axis draws and lock/roll/unknown already exist. This does not prove H1–H6 consequences, kin, rumor propagation, belief correction, surfacing or payoff gameplay. Current selected() reads a cloned module result rather than mutable DOM JSON; no build/browser or test was run here.

F4: F5's specific source concern persists at the inspected seam: main's PLAY handler writes every provenance layer ID into the beginning milestone. The probe's visible text suppresses unknown-axis details but dataset.startResolved serializes provenance containing all axis/id/revision records. Unknown presentation is therefore not a sealed-disclosure contract. The current public-premise layers do not establish that a hidden premise has shipped. Preserve F5/PE10 as a conditional privacy gap for any future sealed consumer, requiring that consumer's actual public DOM/history/export/reload route, rather than claiming all saves must contain no secret bytes. Truth state may need private persistence; opaque IDs can also disclose meaning if public IDs or names encode it. Seed visibility in a solo developer probe is a different policy from hidden truth disclosure.

F5: The world-fit table is a dated inference, not new canon verification or blanket prohibition on a stronger justified premise. Its original Frontier row freezes closed-browser time, while a later subtle-detail bullet promises away-time growth; use the actual selected clock policy, not automatic elapsed absence. Under AD16/AD38, game-time growth and occupied/local/world/wall clocks differ. Substitute payoff actors/tokens/dreams require surviving causal means; a dead participant can leave a changed or unavailable payoff rather than mandatory restoration. Birth relation, legal claim, care, skill, ownership and recognition remain separate. A foundling's NPC body can still need actual care/body support even if the player is human.

F6: PE2–PE12 absence/presence claims remain dated source hypotheses beyond the narrow fresh seams above. Current GR1–GR17/GW5, WER/developer-player policy, AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51 and current world owners govern later work. Committed hidden detail already used by a cause cannot wait to freeze until reveal. Same-species hosts and absent original actors are not automatically invalid seeds if their actual premise works. Retain S1–S5 and RN ideas as proposals, with no1366floor, whole-generator sweep requirement or new Village-first gate. No gameplay/source edits, sealed truth exposure, seed roll, private save, acquisition, worker, deletion, commit or push occurred.

reviews.reopen: Before a sealed premise consumer ships, verify its actual DOM/history/export/knowledge and commit contracts.

reviews.classification: full metadata-source catalogue; no proxy work-body qualification
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual176-line review reads all66 full work rows in PH1–PH10, cross-references, evidence/holdings rules, C1–C5 and RN1–RN10. Section counts8+7+7+6+6+4+7+7+6+8 sum66; inferred priority counts28+28+10 also sum66. Neither count establishes source-body qualification. VERIFIED explicitly means a dated metadata/synopsis or search-summary inspection; native spellings, fit, tone and priority retain independent MEMORY/STATED/INFERRED limits. Weak swapped-daughter rows, recalled details and unresolved near matches remain visibly uncertain.

F2: Preserve the distinct reading questions: cross-species care and learned habits, protective or exploitative swaps, motive-driven misunderstanding, layered household knowledge, latent lineage, unusual arrival vessels, wrong reference groups, actual egg versus small-body/companion starts, staggered or refused reunions and grim inversions. These examples do not make all caretakers oblivious, all lineages gifts or all reunions desirable. A public familiar-work premise is not a newly generated sealed truth; actual hidden selected outcomes follow the project's disclosure rules.

F3: PH8 distinguishes actual egg play, an ant/new creature, a cell-stage game and a rider raising another body. PH7 separates public rank, real capability, social judgment and hidden access. PH9 permits adoptive and birth family to coexist or a reunion to be refused. PH10 shows consequences without making every rescued child or good deed generate punishment. A comic source's coincidence is a proposed premise, not a universal mechanism turning rumor into truth. Each source's adaptation/edition/continuity and relevant causal details need inspection before implementation.

F4: F2/C2 holdings are historical filename/title checks, not present absence, valid file identity, imported/read state or permission to reacquire. Current library catalogues and chapter-range coverage own that question. RN rankings and reading-time suggestions remain proposals, not dispatch, acquisition, buying, new build order or frontier permission. Failed-route history and the unidentified clip stay preserved; this pass did not search upstream pages or ask for the clip again. The audit's new B582 source seam narrows present premise-axis and conditional sealing claims without certifying these works or private sheets. No download, source-body read, library change or runtime work occurred.
